parsed.notes:
TC-03-05 runs on a changed device language: scripts/test-acceptance.sh runs the device-language-tagged flows on the device set to pl-PL, then TC-03-05 again on en-US. It sets the language through adb root, setting persist.sys.locale and restarting the Android framework (zygote), then puts it back. This needs an emulator image without Google Play (CI's google_apis API 31 qualifies); without root the flows are reported blocked, not failed.
The card flows wait 1 s (an optional extendedWaitUntil) before the first touch on a new card, because touches within 0.5 s of a card being drawn are ignored (MOD-03-F14, DEC-40); without the wait TC-03-04 failed once.
Until US-03-02 and US-03-03 the deck is in data order and wraps to the first card after the last (DEC-53). The card text is sized by the longest word (cardType), so long words are not split mid-way.
